body:
Tested locally, it works as expected.

**Testing project:** [test_pr_99504.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18042884/test_pr_99504.zip)

### Some odd cases

#### Keys are not sorted

Keys are not sorted in the dictionary, which means they'll appear in a different order in different files. Is this an issue? If we decide to sort them, it should be done at load-time.

#### Empty tag

An empty tag is included at the end of some WAV files:

```
WAV: Jung.wav
{ "date": "2000-03-26", "": "" }
```

[Jung.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18042463/Jung.zip)

Should we exclude it automatically?

#### Only one tag available in Godot

No tags can be read other than the artist, and a warning is printed when the WAV is loaded:

```
WARNING: Reading less data than requested
     at: get_buffer (./core/io/file_access_memory.cpp:133)

WAV: 01 - Title Theme (Main Menu)
{ "artist": "David Wise", "": "" }
```

[01 - Title Theme (Main Menu).zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18042497/01.-.Title.Theme.Main.Menu.zip)

Dolphin can read all the tags successfully, including an embedded cover:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2f65493b-c16a-48b1-b387-1f170265e21a)

(Godot is able to play back that file successfully when loaded at runtime.)

#### Files failing to load

This file fails to load in Godot, but other apps can play them back successfully.

```
ERROR: Not a WAV file. File should start with 'RIFF', but found 'ID3', in file of size 7057536 bytes
   at: load_from_buffer (./scene/resources/audio_stream_wav.cpp:802)

WAV: inter.wav
```

[inter.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18042539/inter.zip)

Interestingly, "ID3" is the name of a metadata standard. Does that mean metadata is put before the RIFF file header in some WAV files?
Tested locally (rebased on top of `master` https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/2303ce843a362cf5497ca3336451de23793eb711), it works as expected. Code looks good to me.
